# Refined connectome meshes (adds 16, 32 and 64 cells per edge; the files at
# 1, 2, 4 and 8 cells are regenerated byte-identical).
python3 scripts/prepare-fornari-connectome.py

cmake -S . -B build-release -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build-release --target test_ordering_study

python3 scripts/run-ordering-study.py \
  --output-dir output/fisher_kolmogorov/corti83/ordering_study

cp output/fisher_kolmogorov/corti83/ordering_study/validation.csv \
   benchmarks/28_sequential_ordering_study/results/validation.csv
cp output/fisher_kolmogorov/corti83/ordering_study/ordering_study.csv \
   benchmarks/28_sequential_ordering_study/results/ordering_study.csv
